name: Timeline: The Future Awaits
summary:
You receive a message from someone who claims to be writing from the year 2065.
What sounds like a bad joke quickly turns serious: a virus will break out in 2030 – and wipe out humanity.
Five friends are meant to develop a cure. But why is your name in the photo next to the formula?

You become part of a group where not everyone is who they claim to be.
Someone is lying. Someone is betraying you. And someone is writing to you from a future that shouldn’t even exist anymore.
Who do you trust – and who do you judge too soon?
